duration.text: The Logistics Management at Bohai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport(liaoning) 1). The first page of the passport (Indentity Page).With photo, passport number &expiration date and full name. 2). Two blank pages of the passport. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Be healthy.
